title: Wordham Tuitam Kakhane
title_translation: Higher Secondary Tangkhul Literature Reader, Part II
creator: Tangkhul Literature Society Editorial Board
author: Tangkhul Literature Society
notes: Council of Higher Secondary Education Manipur (COHSEM) Class XII literature textbook featuring mature Tangkhul creative writing, social philosophy essays, and literary criticism.
indigenous_tangkhul_text: Wordham Tuitam Kakhane Class XII final higher secondary literature textbook-li peak intellectual achievements curate sakya.
Visionary poetry (Ngashan Kathara), drama criticism, epic folklore analysis, kala advanced stylistic essays sanga.
Collegiate level linguistic research kala creative authorship-wui solid foundation lay sakya.
english_translation_text: Wordham Tuitam Kakhane is the pinnacle Class XII higher secondary literature textbook under COHSEM.
Featuring visionary modernist poetry, drama criticism, analysis of oral epics, and advanced stylistic essays.
It establishes a solid foundation for university research in Tibeto-Burman linguistics and indigenous creative writing.
literary_themes: The pinnacle of high school mother-tongue education
Modernist poetry, tribal identity, and political consciousness
Literary theory applied to indigenous oral traditions
structure_and_meter: University-preparatory anthology featuring complex literary essays, stylistic critiques, and creative composition guides.
critical_commentary: Published in 2021, this volume represents the highest official level of school literature education in the Tangkhul language.

poetic_vocabulary_terms.Ngashan Kathara: The new dawn of intellectual and creative awakening
poetic_vocabulary_terms.Lairik-Otshak: Literary scholarship and published creative work
